title: Director IT-  Manufacturing and Supply Chain Technology
text:
We believe power is a promise - a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most. 

 For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

 Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?
 


 The IT Director- Manufacturing and Supply Chain Technology is a senior technology leader within the Business Technology Management group responsible for the strategy, execution, and continuous improvement of enterprise systems that enable manufacturing, supply chain, and operations. This role requires deep experience in the manufacturing and supply chain verticals, with expertise in SAP ECC–based ERP environments and tightly integrated operational technologies.
 Serve as the strategic bridge between Manufacturing, Supply Chain Operations, Corporate Development, and IT—ensuring that core platforms such as SAP ECC, SAP Ariba, SIOP planning solutions, MES, TMS, and WMS ecosystems are optimized to drive reliability, cost efficiency, service levels, and scalability.
 
 Technology Strategy & Roadmap 
 Define and execute the multi-year technology roadmap for manufacturing and supply chain systems aligned to business growth objectives.

 Own the strategy and lifecycle management of SAP ECC across production planning (PP), materials management (MM), sales & distribution (SD), quality management (QM), plant maintenance (PM), and OTC integrations

 Ensure alignment between ERP, procurement, planning, and shop-floor systems to enable end-to-end process visibility.

 Evaluate and modernize SIOP planning capabilities to improve forecast accuracy, capacity planning, and inventory optimization.

 
 Manufacturing Systems Leadership 
 Lead strategy and governance for MES platforms, ensuring tight integration between shop-floor control systems and SAP ECC.

 Drive digitization initiatives across production, quality, maintenance, and traceability.

 Oversee WMS and TMS platforms to ensure seamless warehouse execution, logistics optimization, and transportation visibility.

 Improve plant-level KPIs through system enablement and data integrity.

 
 SAP & Supply Chain Optimization 
 Oversee end-to-end integration between SAP ECC , SAP Ariba , SIOP planning tools, and TMS

 Ensure procurement workflows, supplier collaboration, and spend management are optimized within Ariba.

 Drive master data governance across materials, BOMs, routings, vendors, customers, and logistics networks.

 Partner with Finance to ensure accurate cost accounting, inventory valuation, and manufacturing variance reporting.

 
  O perational Excellence & Reliability 
 Working within our established IT Operating Model, establish strong IT-business governance with manufacturing, supply chain, and procurement leadership.

 Ensure system reliability, uptime, and performance across mission-critical operational platforms.

 Lead continuous improvement initiatives

 Implement strong change management practices to ensure adoption across plant and warehouse environments.

 
 Team & Vendor Leadership 
 Build and lead high-performing ERP, Manufacturing, OTC, Product Lifecycle Management and supply chain technology teams (internal and external).

 Manage system integrators, managed services providers, and software vendors.

 Establish clear SLAs and performance metrics for operational support and project delivery.

 Develop internal capability in SAP ECC manufacturing and supply chain modules.

 
 Minimum Job Requirements 
 
 Education 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business, or related field or equivalent experience
 
 Work Experience 
 12+ years of progressive IT leadership experience in the manufacturing sector

 Deep hands-on functional and technical expertise in SAP ECC 

 Proven experience implementing and optimizing MES, WMS, and TMS solutions within complex manufacturing environments.

 Demonstrated experience leading SIOP (Sales, Inventory & Operations Planning) system enablement.

 Experience integrating SAP Ariba with SAP ECC environments.

 Strong understanding of manufacturing costing, supply chain planning, inventory optimization, and logistics execution

 
 Knowledge / Skills / Abilities 
 Deeply knowledgeable in manufacturing operations and plant-floor realities—not just enterprise IT.

 Fluent in SAP ECC manufacturing and supply chain processes.

 Data-driven and operationally rigorous.

 Capable of translating operational strategy into scalable technology solutions.

 Comfortable operating in complex, multi-plant environments where uptime and execution discipline are critical.

 
 Preferred Job Requirements 
 
 Education 
 MBA
 Work Experience 
 5+ years of ERP leadership in an organization executing acquisitions
